project.title: Atlassian Project Management Cloud Migration

parentsummary.deliverables: Migrated HighRoads' on-premises Atlassian JIRA and Confluence instances to cloud/SaaS versions, executing production application upgrades, test-driven change management, Bash and SQL scripting automation, AWS cloud archiving of legacy systems for historical lookups, and structured access control model definition for the migrated environment.
parentsummary.outcomes: Completed the Atlassian cloud migration with full configuration remediation, decommissioned on-premises servers, and established an AWS-hosted archiving solution for legacy system lookups, enabling the organization to reduce internal IT headcount while maintaining operational continuity.

challenge.summary: HighRoads US was executing an IT strategy shift to eliminate on-premises infrastructure, migrating all internal services to cloud and SaaS platforms as part of an organizational restructuring that would reduce internal IT headcount. Atlassian JIRA and Confluence — both running on-premises — required production-grade migration to cloud versions with full configuration remediation, access control redesign, and an archiving solution for legacy system lookups post-decommission.

deliverables: Test driven change management to remediate cloud feature-function manual configurations
Coordinated migration requirements with development, QA, IT, sales, and executive stakeholders
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Map to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA
Structured the Atlassian JIRA and Confluence access control model for the cloud migration
Migration Review and end user documentation
Migration of on-premise servers into AWS cloud
AWS Cloud automation for archiving and auto-build & start process for legacy system lookups
Provide documentation, knowledge transfer, and cross-training

outcomes: ✅ Successfully migrated HighRoads US Atlassian JIRA and Confluence from on-premises to cloud/SaaS, completing all configuration remediation and access control definition within the engagement window
✅ Delivered AWS-hosted archiving solution for legacy system lookups, enabling on-premises server decommission while preserving historical data access
✅ Enabled IT headcount reduction by transitioning on-premises Atlassian administration responsibilities to the cloud vendor
